id: \rI hear they are giving away fossils somewhere close.
en: \rI hear they are giving away fossils somewhere close.
it: \rHo sentito che qui vicino regalano fossili.

id: \rYou're still here? How did you even make it this far?
en: \rYou're still here? How did you even make it this far?
it: \rSei ancora qui? Come hai fatto ad arrivare fin qui?

id: \rYou must have a lot of commitment.
en: \rYou must have a lot of commitment.

id: \bI've seen it only once. I hope to one day see it again.
en: \bI've seen it only once. I hope to one day see it again.
it: \bL'ho visto solo una volta. Spero di rivederlo un giorno.

id: \bI'm in the mood for a fight.
en: \bI'm in the mood for a fight.

id: \rI've gotten lost trying to take every path.
en: \rI've gotten lost trying to take every path.
it: \rMi sono persa cercando di percorrere tutti i sentieri.

id: \rMisty: \PN, what a coincidence. I just started a new journey after seeing you win the World Coronation Series. You were amazing.
en: \rMisty: \PN, what a coincidence. I just started a new journey after seeing you win the World Coronation Series. You were amazing.
it: \rMisty: \PN, che coincidenza. Ho appena iniziato un nuovo viaggio dopo averti visto vincere la World Coronation Series. Sei stato fantastico.

id: \rOf course, I've gotten stronger too. Let me show you.
en: \rOf course, I've gotten stronger too. Let me show you.
it: \rOvviamente anch'io sono diventata più forte. Lascia che te lo dimostri.

id: \rMisty: What did you think of Clauncher? Isn't he amazing?
en: \rMisty: What did you think of Clauncher? Isn't he amazing?
it: \rMisty: Che ne pensi di Clauncher? Non è fantastico?

id: \bI might go swimming soon. What do you think?
en: \bI might go swimming soon. What do you think?
it: \bForse tra poco vado a nuotare. Che ne dici?
